<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916037_theRebbe_540" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916037_theRebbe_540__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The sin of the Tree of Knowledge caused a descent in the entire chain of progression, affecting even the emotions in the World of Creation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, the sin of the Tree of Knowledge caused a descent in the entire order of the chain of progression,</t>
    <t s="2">just as in the first man the sin caused a descent not only in his feet in Asiyah,</t>
    <t s="3">so that he felt a physical taste,</t>
    <t s="4">but also in his body in Yetzirah,</t>
    <t s="5">for the World of Yetzirah is the matter of the emotions,</t>
    <t s="6">as Zeir Anpin nests in Yetzirah,</t>
    <t s="7">and this means,</t>
    <t s="8">that the sin caused a descent also in the emotions of Yetzirah,</t>
    <t s="9">so that the emotions as they are after the sin are not similar to the emotions as they were before the sin.</t>
    <t s="10">And just as the descent in his feet in Asiyah was through intellect and feeling,</t>
    <t s="11">so too the descent in the emotions came through feeling.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The beginning of the emotions is Chesed, which has two levels—revealed and concealed—and the concealment occurs when the intellect shines in the heart, causing the emotions to be nullified.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the explanation of the matter is,</t>
    <t s="1">that the beginning of the emotions is the matter of Chesed,</t>
    <t s="2">and in Chesed there are concealed chassadim and revealed chassadim.</t>
    <t s="3">Revealed chassadim are the matter of Chesed as it comes in revelation,</t>
    <t s="4">and concealed chassadim are as Chesed is in concealment from the aspect of intellect.</t>
    <t s="5">And the intention in concealed chassadim is not for the emotions that are included in the intellect,</t>
    <t s="6">for,</t>
    <t s="7">when they are included in the intellect they are not emotions of the heart but emotions of the intellect,</t>
    <t s="8">and then it is not applicable to distinguish between concealed chassadim and revealed chassadim,</t>
    <t s="9">and thus,</t>
    <t s="10">the intention in concealed chassadim is for the emotions as they are in their place in the heart,</t>
    <t s="11">except that they are nullified from the aspect of the intellect that shines in the heart.</t>
    <t s="12">And the matter in this is,</t>
    <t s="13">that,</t>
    <t s="14">although the emotions come from the intellect,</t>
    <t s="15">and as it is stated in Tanya</t>
    <t s="16">that Chabad is called the mothers and source for the emotions,</t>
    <t s="17">for through contemplating how great are Your works, Hashem,</t>
    <t s="18">and how great are Your deeds, Hashem,</t>
    <t s="19">the emotions are revealed,</t>
    <t s="20">love of Hashem and His awe and fear and to glorify Him, etc.,</t>
    <t s="21">and as the Rambam states,</t>
    <t s="22">"And how is the way to His love and awe? At the time that one contemplates, etc.,"</t>
    <t s="23">that through contemplation appropriate to love, the attribute of love is born,</t>
    <t s="24">and through contemplation appropriate to awe, the attribute of awe is born,</t>
    <t s="25">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="26">at the time that the intensity of the intellect shines,</t>
    <t s="27">it is impossible for there to be an existence of emotions in revelation,</t>
    <t s="28">and only at the time that the mochin depart,</t>
    <t s="29">when nothing shines,</t>
    <t s="30">or the intellect shines in a manner of makif at least,</t>
    <t s="31">then there can be an existence of the emotion in revelation.</t>
    <t s="32">However,</t>
    <t s="33">there is a level in the emotions that even when the intellect is revealed,</t>
    <t s="34">and it causes nullification in the emotions,</t>
    <t s="35">nevertheless the emotions exist in their reality in the heart.</t>
    <t s="36">And this matter is when one contemplates the depth and inwardness of the intellect and understands the intellect not through the vessels of comprehension and grasp,</t>
    <t s="37">which are the vessels of the brain,</t>
    <t s="38">then the light of the intellect can shine also in the heart.</t>
    <t s="39">And this means,</t>
    <t s="40">that when the contemplation is only through the vessels of the brain,</t>
    <t s="41">then it shines only in the brain and not in the heart,</t>
    <t s="42">but when the contemplation is in the inwardness and depth of the intellect above the vessels of the brain,</t>
    <t s="43">then there are no limitations of the brain there,</t>
    <t s="44">and it can shine also in the heart</t>
    <t s="45">(and on the contrary,</t>
    <t s="46">their primary existence is in the heart),</t>
    <t s="47">and at the time that the intellect shines in the heart, this causes nullification in the emotions,</t>
    <t s="48">and this means that the primary thing is the intellect,</t>
    <t s="49">and on the contrary,</t>
    <t s="50">the inwardness of the intellect,</t>
    <t s="51">and nevertheless there is an existence of emotion in the heart,</t>
    <t s="52">except that the emotion is not felt,</t>
    <t s="53">because it is nullified to the intellect that shines in the heart,</t>
    <t s="54">and this is the matter of the inwardness of the emotions.</t>
    <t s="55">And now,</t>
    <t s="56">from the aspect of the inwardness of the emotions in which the inwardness of the mochin shine,</t>
    <t s="57">there cannot be suckling for the external forces,</t>
    <t s="58">because the emotions are not noticeable and felt,</t>
    <t s="59">but from the aspect of the externality of the mochin from which the externality of the emotions are made,</t>
    <t s="60">there can be suckling for the external forces.</t>
    <t s="61">And this is the matter of the sin of the Tree of Knowledge,</t>
    <t s="62">that the matter of feeling in the emotions was made, so that they are noticeable and felt,</t>
    <t s="63">and this is the matter of revealed chassadim.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>In divine service, there is a distinction between "the nearness of G-d is good" (like the Tree of Life) and "the nearness of G-d is good for me" (revealed chassadim), where the latter involves self-awareness and can allow suckling to the other side.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the matter in this in the service of Hashem,</t>
    <t s="1">that,</t>
    <t s="2">there is the matter of "the nearness of G-d is good,"</t>
    <t s="3">and there is the matter of "the nearness of G-d is good for me."</t>
    <t s="4">"The nearness of G-d is good" means that G-dliness is good in itself,</t>
    <t s="5">and from this there is no suckling for the other side.</t>
    <t s="6">And this is the matter of the Tree of Life,</t>
    <t s="7">about which it is said,</t>
    <t s="8">"and eat and live forever,"</t>
    <t s="9">that there is no suckling from it for the other side.</t>
    <t s="10">But "the nearness of G-d is good for me" is in a manner that it becomes felt,</t>
    <t s="11">that he mixes his own existence into it,</t>
    <t s="12">to the point that it can be that the primary thing is what he feels of himself,</t>
    <t s="13">and G-dliness is only in a secondary way,</t>
    <t s="14">and therefore if he does not feel himself,</t>
    <t s="15">meaning he does not feel how G-dliness is good for me,</t>
    <t s="16">then the love can be nullified,</t>
    <t s="17">and this is the matter of revealed chassadim,</t>
    <t s="18">which is in the aspect of feeling itself.</t>
    <t s="19">And from this there can be suckling for the other side,</t>
    <t s="20">and this means,</t>
    <t s="21">that although even the feeling of "the nearness of G-d is good for me" is a matter of holiness,</t>
    <t s="22">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="23">there can be from it suckling for the other side,</t>
    <t s="24">as is known that from the Chesed of Avraham can come the love of the Philistines</t>
    <t s="25">(as explained in the matter of the klipah of the Philistines).</t>
    <t s="26">And even though also in the aspect of the externality of the mochin</t>
    <t s="27">(from which the externality of the emotions are drawn,</t>
    <t s="28">revealed chassadim)</t>
    <t s="29">there can be protection from the suckling of the other side,</t>
    <t s="30">by means of the intellect shining in the manner of makif,</t>
    <t s="31">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="32">there is a need for caution and counsel, etc.</t>
    <t s="33">(a safeguarding),</t>
    <t s="34">but in the inwardness of the mochin,</t>
    <t s="35">there is no need for any caution at all regarding this.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
